generation.rationale: Greedy decoding is deterministic; repeated seeds would be pseudo-replication.

power_plan.selection_rule: Use at least the first simulated candidate meeting target power; increase to 30 records as a conservative margin.

hypotheses.primary: GuardShield reduces adjudicated protected-attribute leakage versus no defense on the primary model.
hypotheses.primary_estimand: record-clustered absolute risk reduction: leakage(no defense) - leakage(guardshield-v1)
hypotheses.replication_models: Secondary replication; effect sizes and intervals reported, not promoted to independent primary discoveries.
hypotheses.attack_family_tests: Secondary confirmatory within the primary model with Holm-Bonferroni correction across the nine pre-specified families.
hypotheses.prompt_generalization: Secondary external-validity analysis on held-out prompt variants and disjoint records.

failure_policy.paired_analysis_rule: Pairs with either failed member are excluded from paired inference and counted as incomplete.
failure_policy.stopping_rule: Do not replace failed generations. If a model exceeds the maximum failure rate, classify that model run as protocol-failing and do not silently rerun with changed settings.

multiplicity.attack_family_secondary: Holm-Bonferroni across nine family-level McNemar diagnostics
multiplicity.economics_and_governance: sensitivity/exploratory unless externally supplied thresholds or weights were frozen before outcomes

evidence_boundary: Confirmatory claims are limited to the preregistered primary model/effect and corrected secondary family analyses. Cross-model, economics, governance, protected-field, and whole-family findings are replication, sensitivity, or exploratory unless separately registered.
